system.longDesc:
You are a master of secrets.

Grandmaster and Apex degrees for the talent of the same name in the Modern AGE Basic Rulebook.

degree3.desc: You have mastered all kinds of social interactions. The benefits of the Novice and Expert degrees now apply to all Etiquette, Deception, and Seduction tests.

degree4.desc: A word from you can move empires. The Cast Out and Oozing Confidence stunts only cost 1 SP each for you. You can spend additional SP when you use these stunts to target one additional person for each extra SP spent.
